column1: # C# NepDateRange (NR01-NR04, NR06, NR15-NR21, NR27, NR30). Ranges are inclusive.
# D-01: a port has no empty range, so start > end is ERR and Intersect with no overlap is
# none; C# returns an empty range for both.
# D-16: C# also throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException at the data end. IsAdjacentTo throws
# when a range ends at 2199-12-30, and Intersect of disjoint ranges throws when the
# receiver starts at 1901-01-01; those rows hold the port's value.
